item.title: GTA 6 just broke a Netflix record even Rockstar didn't see coming, and the map's size explains why
item.description: The Extended Look became the number 1 most-watched title on Netflix, beating out movie premieres. It was also confirmed that GTA 6's map will be about three times bigger than Red Dead Redemption 2's.

item.title: Beyond the gameplay: everything Rockstar revealed today about GTA 6 that almost nobody is talking about
item.description: Between the Extended Look and an exclusive interview with Dazed, Rockstar confirmed a real fashion system, in-game streamers, the return of Snapmatic, and even the ability to pet dogs.

item.title: Everything we know about GTA 6 so far (and why it is not just rumors anymore)
item.description: Release date, price, editions, protagonists and map: we cover everything officially confirmed about GTA 6 ahead of launch.
